children: Shares of Northern ARC Capital Ltd. gained over 7% on Monday, August 31 after a large trade that took place in the stock during the pre-market block window.
As many as 1.1 crore shares, or 6.25% equity of the company, changed hands during the transaction, as per the data available. The value of the transaction is ₹308 crore.
The official buyers and sellers in the block deal are not yet known.

Northern ARC Capital does not have a classified promoter, according to the most recent shareholding pattern of the company shared with the exchanges. 100% of the sharholding is held by those classified as public shareholders.

Among the public shareholders, India's Mutual Funds owned only 0.19% stake in the company at the end of the June quarter, while Alternate Investment Funds had a 3.83% stake. Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation or (SMBC) also had a 3.76% stake in the company, while over 86,000 small retail investors, or those with authorized share capital of up to ₹2 lakh, had a 13% stake. Retail investors with authorized share capital above ₹2 lakh, also had a 12.65% stake.

Eight Roads Investments Mauritius (II) Ltd. (6.87%), Leapfrog Financial Inclusion India (II) Ltd. (16.15%), Accion Africa-Asia Investment Company (3.08%), Augusta Investments II Pte. Ltd. (16.02%), and International Finance Corporation (6.07%) also feature among the company's prominent shareholders.
Northern Arc Capital reported its first quarter earnings last month.
The company's net interest income (NII) grew 44.2% to ₹496.1 crore from ₹344.1 crore. Meanwhile its total revenue was up 30% at ₹767.5 crore from ₹590.6 crore in the year-ago period.
Its provisions stood at ₹110.5 crore compared to ₹103 crore last fiscal and its basic earnings per share (EPS) were up to ₹7.54 from ₹6.42 last year.

The company said its lending assets under management (AUM) increased 26% to ₹16,855 crore, while direct-to-customer (D2C) lending AUM increased 51% to ₹10,766 crore, which accounted for 64% of the overall lending AUM.
Shares of Northern ARC Capital are trading 9% higher after the block deal at ₹311.3. The stock is up 25% so far in 2026.

title: Northern ARC Capital shares worth ₹308 crore change hands in block deal; Stock jumps over 9%
